description: Two polyphonic oscillators, each fading through four waves, with two FM inputs, pulse width control and sync, and both mixed at a master output

params.text: Sets that oscillator's character: analogue drifts in tune and softens the corners of the wave, digital does neither
Chooses what the sync input does to that oscillator: hard restarts the cycle, soft reverses it instead
Sets that oscillator's pitch in semitones, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets how much of that oscillator reaches the master output
Attenuates and inverts the FM I input for that oscillator
Attenuates and inverts the FM II input for that oscillator
Sets the width of that oscillator's pulse, from 1% to 99%
Attenuates and inverts the PWM input for that oscillator
Fades that oscillator through sine, triangle, sawtooth and square

inputs.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch, a volt to the octave, added to its Hz knob
Modulates that oscillator's pitch a volt to the octave, attenuated by its FM I knob
Modulates that oscillator's frequency directly in hertz rather than by the octave, attenuated by its FM II knob
Resets that oscillator's cycle, hard or soft as its sync switch is set
Moves the width of that oscillator's pulse, attenuated by its PWM knob, 10V covering the whole range
Fades that oscillator through sine, triangle, sawtooth and square, 0-10V covering all four and added to the WAVE knob

outputs.text: The A oscillator's wave, between -5V and 5V
The A oscillator's wave inverted, between -5V and 5V
The B oscillator's wave, between -5V and 5V, despite the panel printing OUT B-
The B oscillator's wave inverted, between -5V and 5V, despite the panel printing OUT B
Both oscillators mixed at the levels their level knobs set
